scope: Manually retrieved manufacturer evidence for six seeded products; candidates are not confirmed household packs or runtime rules.

rules: Preserve manufacturer cap/scoop marks; do not invent ml or g conversions.
Keep ingredient capabilities separate from dosing and compatibility permission.
Not listed in a disclosure is not laboratory-confirmed absence.
Retain provider IDs, source dates and route-specific conditions; do not merge variants by fuzzy name.
Manufacturer benefit claims do not establish comparative effectiveness.

detergentDoseEvaluation.userConcern: Avoid detergent overdosing, especially in HE machines.
detergentDoseEvaluation.manufacturerIntent: No evidence retrieved establishing that cap marks are intentionally deceptive.

sources.scope: General household advice, not the owned commercial model manual
sources.finding: Suggests approximately one tablespoon for regular loads and potentially less for lightly worn clothing, while directing users to the machine manual. The numeric advice links an external article.
Directs users to the detergent bottle instructions.

sources.scope: General HE guidance, not a Speed Queen model specification
sources.finding: Gives a typical two-tablespoon HE example but explicitly makes dosing dependent on concentration and machine/product instructions.
Excess detergent can cause oversudsing, poor rinsing and cleaning, and longer cycles; concentration, soil and load size affect dosing.
Insufficient detergent for soil or hardness can redeposit soil.

detergentDoseEvaluation.boundary: Do not impose a universal tablespoon dose, treat dispenser maximum as a target, equate cap marks across variants, or silently reduce antimicrobial doses/contact times. Reconcile model and product evidence before choosing an amount; record intentional routine changes separately.
detergentDoseEvaluation.units: Use US English presentation; retain original source marks and units. Convert verified volume to US customary measurements when requested, with appropriate rounding; tablespoon volumes do not establish powder mass.
